title: The Pie Register WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform any capability, nonce or authentication check on…
description: The Pie Register WordPress plugin versions through 3.8.4.15 have a vulnerability where one of its request handlers lacks capability, nonce, or authentication checks. This allows unauthenticated attackers to reset the plugin's settings to defaults, disabling registration security controls like new-user email verification, and to destroy a plugin data table.
